bio_en: Harutyun Abrahamian, known as Cholo, was born in 1878 in Shenik in Sasun; illiterate and unable to bear Turkish abuse, he went to the Caucasus in 1894, where he met Aram Aramian and Hrayr and returned with them to the homeland. By 1898 he was in the band of Makar of Spaghank, and in November 1899 fought when 200 armed Turks and Kurds attacked after Serob's death; the villagers killed Karapet, one of Serob's betrayers. He attended the historic Shenik meeting of 1901 with Andranik, Hrayr and others, and fought with Andranik's chosen men in the 1904 uprising. He later fought in the 1915 Sasun resistance.
